expert.name: Riya
expert.quote: Four cities and two countries in eight days. It moves quickly, but every flight is short and every day has something in it.
expert.tip: Pack a light long sleeve for Angkor. Shoulders need covering at the temples and the sun is unforgiving by ten.

summary: Eight days across four cities in two countries: Hanoi with a half day cruise on Halong Bay, a guided morning of the capital, a night in Da Nang with Ba Na Hills and the Golden Bridge, two in Siem Reap for a full day at Angkor, then two in Saigon with the city and the Cu Chi tunnels.
included: Included: 7 nights with breakfast daily and dinner at the Vietnamese and Cambodian hotels; all flights between the cities; private transfers throughout; a half day cruise on Halong Bay; a Hanoi city tour; a full day at Ba Na Hills with the Golden Bridge; a full day Siem Reap tour with Angkor Wat; a Saigon city tour; the Cu Chi tunnels half day tour.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Vietnam and Cambodia visa fees; lunches; travel insurance; personal expenses.
